lines.ruling: Ruling: representation; the candidate takes line 6 when div.any is yes and zero when it is no; the project takes box 1a (sb.ordinary_dividends) when div.any is yes and zero otherwise, and line 6 is a copy of this gate line with the Schedule B refusals, so the two agree on every return where line 6 is not refused (a refused line 6 refuses the return either way). Ruled by reading: the scoped reply names interfaces the candidate bank does not resolve, as in the earlier line-scoped passes of this lane.

Ruling: model error; the candidate copies sb.ordinary_dividends whether or not the filer received dividends or other distributions (div.any), so it needs that answer where the source does not: i1040sb p. 2, Line 5, "Report on line 5 all of your ordinary dividends. This amount should be shown in box 1a of your Forms 1099-DIV or substitute statements": a filer who received no dividends has none to report. The project copies the gate line sb.ordinary_dividends_if_dividends, which takes sb.ordinary_dividends when div.any holds and zero otherwise; the interview asks sb.ordinary_dividends only then (gated_by), so on every return the interview can produce the two agree. The line was rescoped because the wording of the foreign screens its refusal gates read changed (the spouse phrase); its expression is unchanged. Ruled by reading.
